name: Tidefrost Palm
description: Strike with a palm that arrives as flowing water and sets as hard cold on the skin.

name: Dewglaze Guard
description: Spread a film of water qi over the forearms and let it glaze to a thin hard shell.

name: Wavechill Slide
description: Slide forward on a skin of water that chills and slicks the ground under the feet.

name: Slush Pull
description: Drag the opponent's feet into half-frozen slush and strike as the legs stick.

name: Meltwater Mend
description: Soothe an ally's frostbitten or swollen limb with slow warm meltwater qi until the colour returns.

name: Hardening Current
description: Let a flowing current stiffen on the body into a shell that jars each strike that lands on it.

name: Floodfrost Crush
description: Pour a heavy flood onto the target and freeze it at the moment of impact into a crushing weight.

name: Glassy Flood
description: Spread a thin flood across the ground and glaze it so the footing of every opponent gives way.

name: Stillwater Seal
description: Still the water in the foe's veins until the cold sets and the qi paths are locked.

name: Hoarwave
description: streams: Water + Ice; roll a great wave across the field and freeze it mid-crest so it falls as a shattering weight.

name: Tidesilt Palm
description: Strike with a palm heavy with silt-laden water qi that hits with the weight of wet earth.

name: Rainloam Guard
description: Pack a layer of rain-soaked loam qi over the forearms that soaks up the force of a blow.

name: Floodclay Slide
description: Slide across slick ground on a skin of watery clay with the stance low and wide.

name: Dewloam Salve
description: Press a warm paste of dew and loam qi to an ally's wound to seal it and feed the flesh.

name: Currentsilt Pull
description: Bog the opponent's feet in thick silty qi and strike the held body before it can climb free.

name: Wavesilt Wash
description: Pass a silty wave through a poisoned ally so the loam draws the venom into itself.

name: Sediment Veil
description: Hang a slow-settling veil of sediment before the body that thickens against every strike.

name: Floodsilt Press
description: Lean a silt-heavy flood onto the opponent so the strike lands and the legs sink under the weight.

name: Tidesilt Crash
description: Drive a silt-laden tide through the fist in one blow that bruises the bone beneath the guard.

name: Dragging Mudflow
description: Turn the ground round the user to a flowing mud that drags and holds every opponent in it.

name: Siltflow Absorb
description: Swallow a heavy strike into a body of thick silty water and let it settle into reserve.

name: Loamflood
description: streams: Water + Earth; send a heavy flood of earth-laden water over the field that buries foes and feeds allies.

name: Tidesteam Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a scalding gout of steamed water qi into the target.

name: Rainsteam Guard
description: Throw up a hissing cloud of steam from the guard hand so that strikes glance off the heat.

name: Wavesteam Slide
description: Slide across the ground behind a burst of steam that hides the first two paces.

name: Scalding Spray
description: Whip a thin line of scalding water qi across the opponent's hands and face.

name: Warmwater Mend
description: Soak an ally's stiff or chilled wound in warm water qi that loosens the flesh and speeds mending.

name: Steamveil Ward
description: Hold a veil of hot mist round the body that scalds anything that tries to pass through.

name: Scaldwater Wash
description: Boil poison and rot from an ally's wound with a brief wash of near-scalding water qi.

name: Boilcurrent Burst
description: Heat a current in the palm to a boil and burst it against the target in one blow.

name: Boiling Flood
description: Pour a flood of boiling water qi over the nearby opponents until they reel scalded and blind.

name: Vapour Vanish
description: Burst into steam and re-form a long way off before the cloud has begun to thin.

name: Boilwave
description: streams: Water + Fire; hold flame and wave against each other until the boundary bursts as one scalding breaker.

name: Dewrime Palm
description: Strike with a palm slick with dew that glazes over on the target's skin.

name: Streamglaze Guard
description: Lay a stream of qi over the arms and glaze it into a smooth hard sheet.

name: Rillfrost Step
description: Glide across ground made slick by a thin frozen rill of qi laid in front of the feet.

name: Dewrime Salve
description: Numb an ally's burn with cool dewy qi that slows the swelling and lets the skin settle.

name: Streamrime Lash
description: Flick a stinging line of half-frozen spray across the opponent's eyes and hands.

name: Brinefrost Wrap
description: Wrap the opponent's arms in salt water that freezes to a binding cord.

name: Clearglaze Wash
description: Pass a clear cold current through an ally to chill out fever poison and leave the blood clean.

name: Glazewater Veil
description: Wear a veil of water qi glazed thin and bright that scatters thrown blades and spray.

name: Brinerime Crush
description: Hammer the target with a brine-frozen fist that cracks bone and numbs the nerve behind it.

name: Glazing Rainfrost
description: Call a field of freezing rain over the opponents so that every drop lands and glazes where it falls.

name: Glazewater Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of glazed water that blunts blows and slows the qi of those who touch it.

name: Stillrime Seal
description: Glaze the foe's core in still cold water so no qi can flow out of it for a span.

name: Glazing Tide
description: streams: Water + Ice; draw a living tide across the field and glaze it behind the waves so it shatters as it ebbs.

name: Rimeflood
description: streams: Water + Ice; let a deep flood roll over a wide field while a spreading frost locks in each drop.
